title: French Language Services Advisory Committee - September 12, 2024

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom no. 811 8898 5794
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Transit Services Department and French Language Services
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Renée Amilcar, General Manager, Transit Services Department (TSD), and Olivia McGuinty, Manager, Business Support Services, TSD, provided a presentation with an overview of French language services, training, and recruitment in the TSD.
The Advisory Committee discussed and asked questions regarding the following topics:
The Advisory Committee received the presentation for information. 
ACTION:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive the presentation for information and provide feedback as appropriate.

sub_agendas_items.title: City of Ottawa Municipal Accessibility Plan Consultations
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Sarah Bériault, Accessibility Specialist, Legislative Services, Office of the City Clerk, provided a presentation with an overview of the City of Ottawa Municipal Accessibility Plan. 
The Advisory Committee discussed and asked questions regarding the following topics:
The Advisory Committee received the presentation for information.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive the presentation for information and provide feedback as appropriate.

sub_agendas_items.title: Overview and FLSAC Working Group Recommendations - Recreation, Cultural and Facility Services Department
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Member Desaulniers provided a summary of the working group’s recommendations to the Recreation, Cultural and Facility Services Department in response to Goal 1, Activity 1 and Goal 2, Activity 2 of the FLSAC 2023-2026 Work Plan.
The Advisory Committee approved the working group’s report as presented.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the FLSAC Working Group provide an overview of their report and that the French Language Services Advisory Committee approve the working group’s report.

sub_agendas_items.title: Discussion on interest for in-person meetings
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Chair led a discussion to see if members of the Committee would be interested in holding a future meeting in a hybrid format. There was a consensus from members that a hybrid meeting where a quorum of members can be in person would be beneficial, so long as attendance in person is not mandatory. 
The Office of the City Clerk will follow up with next steps.

agenda_items.title: In Camera Items
agenda_items.minutes: There were no in camera items.

agenda_items.title: Notices of Motions (For Consideration at Subsequent Meeting)
agenda_items.minutes: There were no Notices of Motion.
